_comment: `init` writes this file for you (~/.config/vast-paralon-dual/config.json). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_on_paralon_rental: unlist_vast (default) = Vast is unlisted while Paralon is rented and relisted afterwards. keep_vast_listed = Vast stays listed (a Vast booking reclaims the Paralon spot rental).
_paralon_agent: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED, per machine. How to reach Docker on that GPU machine, so the Paralon agent is stopped while a Vast renter has the GPU and started again after: "local" when this tool runs on that machine, or user@host for ssh (key login, a user in the docker group). Leave it out and the agent keeps starting inference and benchmarks beside Vast renters.
_vast_listing: OPTIONAL fallbacks. Before unlisting, the tool saves the machine's own listing (GPU price, min bid, disk, bandwidth, offer end) and relists with that. These values are used only for terms nothing was saved for, e.g. a machine you unlisted by hand. A machine's own vast_listing overrides this one.
_docker_events: follow docker events on each machine with paralon_agent and pause Paralon the moment a non-Paralon container starts
_idle_job_images: image prefixes of your own idle job (e.g. a miner): never counted as a renter
